en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a small town. A dirt or lightly paved road runs through the center, lined with two‑storey wooden and masonry buildings. On the left is an older wooden house with a shopfront at street level and a signboard above the entrance. A few pedestrians walk along the street, some in coats or long dresses, and bicycles are visible. Telephones or power lines run along wooden poles beside the road. Trees partly shade the buildings and the sky is mostly clear.
